description: Terms the OPLS-AA 2024 BOSS files (J. Phys. Chem. B 128, 250 (2024), SI) lack for polymers of CAPS's library, each from the OPLS-AA paper that defines it, and atom types (caps_*) for environments the table has no number for, charged by OPLS-AA's own group increments; bench/ff/convert_boss_opls.py --supplement adds them only where the .sb has no entry (Jorgensen's files win). Units as the .sb: K in kcal/mol/A^2 or /rad^2 (E = K (x - x0)^2), r0 in A, theta0 in degrees.

bonds.source: E. K. Watkins, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Phys. Chem. A 105, 4118 (2001), Table 2
bonds.reason: the paper's perfluoroalkane carbons are class CT (the 2024 files' CF): a fluorinated carbon bonded to a hydrocarbon carbon is its CT-CT, 268.0 / 1.529 (the 2024 files' CF-CF)

angles.reason: the 2024 files' CF is the paper's CT

angles.source: W. L. Jorgensen, D. S. Maxwell, J. Tirado-Rives, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 118, 11225 (1996) (CT-CT-HC); Watkins & Jorgensen 2001
angles.reason: the perfluoroalkane paper has no H; with its CF = CT the bend is OPLS-AA's CT-CT-HC (the 2024 .sb's CT-CT-HC, 37.5 / 110.7)

angles.source: W. Damm, A. Frontera, J. Tirado-Rives, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Comput. Chem. 18, 1955 (1997), Table IV (CT-OS-CT, CT-OS-CO)
angles.reason: the paper's acetal carbon CO takes CT's bonded terms throughout (CT-OS-CO = CT-OS-CT, CT-CO-OS = CT-CT-OS); its C-O-C bend 60.0 / 109.5 (polyoxymethylene's O between two acetal carbons)

angles.source: Damm et al. 1997, Table IV (CT-CT-OS, CT-CO-OS)
angles.reason: CO with CT's bonded terms: CT-CT-OS 50.0 / 109.5
the file gives CY the CT values for bends outside the ring (CY-CT-HC = CT-CT-HC 37.5 / 110.7); CT-CT-CY is then CT-CT-CT, 58.35 / 112.7

atom_types.name: caps_ccl2
atom_types.reason: each Cl (151, -0.200) adds +0.200 to its carbon group, as the 2024 table's RCH2Cl 152 (-0.006 + 2 x 0.103), R2CHCl 973 (0.097 + 0.103) and R3CCl 974 (0.200) do: two Cl, +0.400 (poly(vinylidene chloride))

atom_types.reason: each Cl (151, -0.200) adds +0.200 to its carbon group, as the 2024 table's RCH2Cl 152 (-0.006 + 2 x 0.103), R2CHCl 973 (0.097 + 0.103) and R3CCl 974 (0.200) do: two Cl and one H 0.103, 0.400 - 0.103

atom_types.name: caps_pyr2ch
atom_types.reason: a 2-alkyl group carries pyridine's H2 charge (+0.012): CH3 670 -0.168 + 3 x 0.060, CH2 671 -0.108 + 2 x 0.060; a CH -0.048 + 0.060 (poly(2-vinylpyridine))

atom_types.name: caps_s_poly
atom_types.description: S between two S in a polysulfide
atom_types.reason: each S bonded to a carbon carries the disulfide S charge (203, -0.2175) against its carbon group (213-216, +0.2175); an S bonded only to S has no such partner, so 0

dihedrals.source: E. K. Watkins, W. L. Jorgensen, J. Phys. Chem. A 105, 4118 (2001), Table 5 (general F-CT-CT-F)
dihedrals.reason: the paper's fluorinated carbons are all class CT (the 2024 files' CF for a perfluorinated carbon, CT for a CHF / CH2F carbon); an F-C-C-F torsion between two fluorinated carbons takes its general term
